descriptionHtml:
Lexar NQ780 M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4x4 NVMe SSD (High Speed PCIe Gen 4x4 Performance / Sequential Read Speeds Up to 7000 MB/s / Premium 3D NAND Flash / M.2 2280 Form Factor / PS5 & PC Compatible / Smart Thermal Management / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Experience blazing-fast storage performance with the Lexar NQ780 M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4x4 NVMe SSD, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Powered by high-speed PCIe Gen 4x4 bandwidth and quality 3D NAND flash memory, the NQ780 delivers high sequential read speeds up to 7000 MB/s, vastly reducing load times, boot sequences, and file transfer durations. Designed in a compact M.2 2280 form factor, it offers seamless compatibility with modern desktop motherboards, high-performance laptops, and PlayStation 5 consoles while operating with optimal power efficiency and integrated thermal control.
